description: Lists the countries this site covers with the number of padel hotels in each, or the regions of one country. Use it to see where hotels with padel courts are listed, or to check a place name before searching. The names it returns work as country and region in search_padel_hotels.

country.description: A country, to list its regions. Leave out to list every country.
